name: Marine Biology Camp
operator_name: Roger Williams University, Department of Biology, Marine Biology and Environmental Science
description_short: A one-week overnight marine biology program for rising high school juniors and seniors at Roger Williams University in Bristol, RI. Campers live in a waterside residence hall and do daily field and lab work, including snorkeling, sea kayaking, plankton sampling and a whale-watching trip off Cape Cod, plus guest lectures by RWU scientists. Enrollment is limited to 18 per session.
refund_policy_summary: A $500 deposit is due with the application and can be refunded through April 1. The remaining $1,695 is due by May 10. The page does not say what happens if you cancel after the balance is paid.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers are in or on the water every day: snorkeling along barrier beaches and tidal pools, sea kayaking, and boat trips. Snorkel gear is practiced in the pool on arrival day. RWU lends snorkel gear, or campers can bring their own. The camp says it is not a good fit for students who are uneasy around the water. Swim test requirements are not stated.
